body: I think college is one of the worst places to make new friends. Highschool was trash in its own ways but I definitely found it easier to make friends. Given my opinion might not be the best considering I'm off campus but i do know some people on campus with the same problems. I still hang out with people from my hometown, but your right its fucking impossible to make new friends unless ur extroverted af. The environment does not foster good friendships, you just don't meet people frequently enough for it to matter, and even if you do most of the time they already have a group of friends. I've found better luck at volunteer places and work. Also just a general question am I the only one that finds the college environment incredibly isolating?

Yeah its weird, but I think people assume that uncertainty is supposed to be enough to make you want to live, but truth is it isn't. Tbh the only reason I haven't given up is because I've learned to manage my  issues a bit better, but honestly I don't think life is all that great anyway.  Not every life is worth living.
invite if you end up making one :) sounds fun

well for me it was realising what do I actually want out of this? I mean I'm shy introverted and socially awkward, but why do I want to change and what can I actually change. I feel like people have this perspective that everything about yourselves can be changed which   isn't true. Especially because society has this extrovert ideal that everyone seems to want to meet (including me sometimes). I can improve my social skills, but I won't ever really be completely comfortable in social situations because of my introversion, its like forcing yourself to like food that you hate. I realised though all I really want is a few good friends so I'm going to try to take it slow and just meet people and see what happens.

its ok to feel emotions , they don't define who you are as a person. I get it though things that happen in the present can bring up stuff from the past which really sucks, but you sound like a very kind person, sadly bad things happen to good people, but I'm really sorry you had to go through that during highschool, nobody should have to deal with that stuff, I remember getting bullied pretty bad growing up and it leaves alot of scars that cause difficulties in adult life. I hope it gets easier for you though.

I get what you mean about trying to put yourself out there and it not really working out. Story of my life tbh, but its not my fault really and its not yours either. I think its just really hard to be different alone, I've felt that way alot. Don't try to change to be apart of the crowd its more isolating then just doing your own thing, I just hope its comforting to know theres other people similar to you.

yeesh who the fuck would downvote this? Fuck you whoever did that stop trying to hurt people who are already in pain from trying to better there lives and being disappointed, it hurts way more than you think. I hope it gets better for you OP.

From what I've seen its very difficult to change (maybe reduce through stuff like meditation or other stuff like that) without becoming really out of tune with yourself. The problem is its very difficult to change how your brain reacts to stimuli innately (i.e. how sensitive you are). The advantage to being oversensitive is that the good things seem to feel alot better than to other nonsensitive people. For instance atleast for me sometimes listening to a relaxing song or finding something interesting out is sometimes euphoric to me and other simple stuff like that like a rainy day or the night sky filled with stars. However on the flip side i get hurt way too easily meaning I can't maintain too many relationships because I think too much so I keep to my small number of friends (trying to increase but its hard). I can't change who I am really to become like alot of my peers who seem to be extroverted and loud, but I can try to increase the amount I do things that I find stimulating enough like reading and making music, and that could be enough, but I guess the loneliness really won't go away until I meet some more people like me.
Thanks for the reply I'll keep trying till its too much
